# WorldNIC
> Domain registration, DNS, hosting, email, and website management services from Network Solutions.

WorldNIC provides account access and support resources for managing domains, DNS, email, hosting, SSL, and related web services associated with Network Solutions and Web.com properties.

## Account & Login
- [WorldNIC Login](https://www.worldnic.com/cgi-bin/login): Sign in to manage domains, DNS, hosting, and account services.
- [Account Manager](https://www.worldnic.com/accountmanager): Access account management tools for registered products and services.
- [Password Reset](https://www.worldnic.com/cgi-bin/login?execution=e1s1): Recover account access and reset login credentials.
- [Network Solutions Login](https://www.networksolutions.com/manage-it/index.jsp): Alternate account access for domain and hosting management.

## Domain Management
- [Domain Names](https://www.networksolutions.com/domain-name-registration/index.jsp): Register and manage domain names across common TLDs.
- [WHOIS Lookup](https://www.networksolutions.com/whois/index.jsp): Search domain registration records and ownership details.
- [Domain Transfer](https://www.networksolutions.com/domain-transfer/index.jsp): Transfer existing domains into Network Solutions management.
- [Domain Expiration Help](https://www.networksolutions.com/support/domain-names/): Support resources for renewals, expiration, and domain settings.
- [Premium DNS](https://www.networksolutions.com/online-marketing/premium-dns.jsp): Managed DNS service with enhanced reliability and control.

## DNS & Nameservers
- [Advanced DNS Manager](https://www.networksolutions.com/help/article/advanced-dns-manager): Overview of advanced DNS record management capabilities.
- [Change Name Servers](https://www.networksolutions.com/help/article/changing-name-servers): Instructions for updating authoritative name servers.
- [Manage DNS Records](https://www.networksolutions.com/help/article/managing-advanced-dns-records): Guidance for editing A, CNAME, MX, TXT, and other DNS records.
- [DNS Propagation Help](https://www.networksolutions.com/help/article/dns-propagation): Explanation of DNS update timing and propagation behavior.
- [Domain Pointing](https://www.networksolutions.com/help/article/domain-pointing): Configure domain forwarding and website destination settings.

## Email
- [Business Email](https://www.networksolutions.com/email/index.jsp): Business email hosting and mailbox services for custom domains.
- [Email Setup Help](https://www.networksolutions.com/help/article/email-setup): Configure email clients and mailbox access.
- [Webmail Login](https://webmail.networksolutions.com/): Access hosted email through the webmail interface.
- [Email Troubleshooting](https://www.networksolutions.com/help/article/email-troubleshooting): Resolve common sending, receiving, and login issues.
- [Microsoft 365](https://www.networksolutions.com/email/microsoft-office-365): Hosted Microsoft 365 email and productivity offerings.

## Hosting & Website Services
- [Web Hosting](https://www.networksolutions.com/web-hosting/index.jsp): Shared hosting plans for websites and online applications.
- [Website Builder](https://www.networksolutions.com/website-builder/index.jsp): Create and publish websites using guided site-building tools.
- [WordPress Hosting](https://www.networksolutions.com/web-hosting/wordpress-hosting): Managed WordPress hosting for content-driven sites.
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.networksolutions.com/ssl-certificates/index.jsp): Purchase and manage SSL certificates for website security.
- [Ecommerce](https://www.networksolutions.com/ecommerce/index.jsp): Online store tools for selling products and services.

## Support Center
- [Support Home](https://www.networksolutions.com/help): Main support portal for products, billing, and account issues.
- [Domain Support](https://www.networksolutions.com/support/domain-names/): Help articles for domain registration and management.
- [Email Support](https://www.networksolutions.com/support/email/): Help resources for hosted email products.
- [Hosting Support](https://www.networksolutions.com/support/web-hosting/): Troubleshooting and setup guidance for hosting services.
- [SSL Support](https://www.networksolutions.com/support/ssl-certificates/): Assistance with certificate installation and renewal.
- [Billing Support](https://www.networksolutions.com/support/billing-payments/): Help with invoices, payments, and renewal charges.

## Security & Privacy
- [Domain Privacy](https://www.networksolutions.com/domain-name-registration/private-registration.jsp): Protect registrant contact details with private registration services.
- [SSL Certificates](https://www.networksolutions.com/ssl-certificates/index.jsp): Secure websites and transactions with digital certificates.
- [SiteLock](https://www.networksolutions.com/online-marketing/sitelock.jsp): Website malware scanning and security monitoring services.
- [Security Center](https://www.networksolutions.com/security-center/index.jsp): Security information and protective service offerings.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.networksolutions.com/legal/static-service-agreement.jsp): Legal and privacy-related service terms and policies.

## Billing & Renewals
- [Renew Domain](https://www.networksolutions.com/domain-name-registration/renew-domain-name.jsp): Renew domain registrations to prevent expiration and service interruption.
- [Auto Renew Help](https://www.networksolutions.com/help/article/auto-renewal): Learn how automatic renewal settings work for services.
- [Billing & Payments Support](https://www.networksolutions.com/support/billing-payments/): Manage payment methods, invoices, and account billing questions.
- [Redemption & Recovery](https://www.networksolutions.com/help/article/domain-redemption): Recover expired domains during redemption when eligible.
- [Transfer Lock Help](https://www.networksolutions.com/help/article/domain-transfer-lock): Understand registrar lock settings for domain transfers.

## Legal & Policies
- [Legal Center](https://www.networksolutions.com/legal): Central access to legal terms, agreements, and policy documents.
- [Service Agreement](https://www.networksolutions.com/legal/static-service-agreement.jsp): Terms governing use of domain, hosting, and related services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.networksolutions.com/legal/privacy-policy.jsp): Details on data collection, use, and privacy practices.
- [ICANN Information](https://www.networksolutions.com/legal/icann): ICANN-related registrant rights and responsibilities information.
- [Registrant Rights and Responsibilities](https://www.networksolutions.com/legal/rights-and-responsibilities): Summary of domain registrant obligations and protections.
